sources.title: Employing Simulation to Evaluate Designs: The APEX Approach
sources.access: official catalog; US government work public use permitted; RTOP 548-40-12

sources.title: Apex Reference Manual 3.0 Beta
sources.access: cover image and selected manual text

implemented: Resource-aware scheduling and procedure execution; reported application to simulated human air-traffic-controller behavior for interface evaluation; operational manual documents software interfaces.
learned: No durable autonomous acquisition of procedures established in reviewed material.
designed: Reusable plans, procedure language, resource constraints, decision mechanisms and task domain.
limit: Simulation of operator behavior is not evidence of human-equivalent understanding; no live operational evaluation or learning claim established.
ora: Separate rescheduling and choosing among supplied procedures from acquired competence; NASA RTOP is project funding identifier, not an authenticated procurement contract.
rights: bibliographic identifiers and original synthesis only; no source files redistributed

sources.title: Incremental Object Perception in an Attention-Driven Cognitive Architecture
Inattentional Blindness in a Coupled Perceptual–Cognitive System

sources.authors: Gordon Briggs; Andrew Lovett; Will Bridewell; Paul F. Bello
sources.title: Attentional Strategies and the Transition From Subitizing to Estimation in Numerosity Perception
sources.access: publisher abstract and section 4 excerpts; US Naval Research Laboratory affiliation, no exact award traced

implemented: Attention-centered models of object binding, missed stimuli and quantity estimation; 2023 paper reports two simulations explaining prior behavioral findings.
learned: Working-memory content changes with perception; no lasting acquisition of the attentional policy established by consulted sections.
designed: Single focus, attentional selection, configured strategies and switch conditions, segmentation and approximate number mechanism.
limit: 2023 model approximates timing and uses a simplified mathematical quantity estimate; not a neural-level model or proof of independently formed attentional strategy.
ora: Selective use of information may explain behavioral changes without learning. Distinguish working-state updating from durable acquired knowledge.
rights: bibliographic identifiers and original synthesis only; no source files redistributed

sources.authors: D. Martín; M. Rincón; M. C. García-Alegre; D. Guinea
sources.title: ARDIS: knowledge-based architecture for visual system configuration in dynamic surface inspection
sources.access: publisher metadata and abstract; full methods not reviewed

implemented: Author-reported implementation for configuring and revising visual inspection systems; results for stainless steel and wood.
learned: Autonomous knowledge acquisition not established by abstract; explicit knowledge-injection mode exists.
designed: Domain knowledge partition, configuration task decomposition, inspection algorithms and operation modes.
limit: Two material domains do not establish general transfer or independent knowledge creation. No quantitative efficacy claims from abstract alone.
ora: Reuse of supplied domain knowledge is not equivalent to discovering new knowledge; useful specialized architecture comparator.

sources.authors: Alexander Wendt; Friedrich Gelbard; Martin Fittner; Samer Schaat; Matthias Jakubec; Christian Brandstätter; Stefan Kollmann
sources.title: Decision-Making in the Cognitive Architecture SiMA
sources.access: author-posted manuscript excerpts, abstract and use case; no full audit

implemented: Simulated choices based on bodily-state variables, valuation and stored cases; parameterized use-case evaluations.
learned: Consulted 2015 demonstrations show context-sensitive decisions using available episodes; provenance of stored episodes as acquired knowledge is not established.
designed: Drive and evaluation mechanisms, social norms, action options, model assumptions and scenario parameters.
limit: Authors explicitly describe use-case calibration as a first step; behavior varies without model changes and empirical validation remains future work in that paper. No feelings or biological equivalence demonstrated.
ora: Prior art for needs-linked goal selection; differentiate authored drive models, dynamic intermediate goals, and actual acquisition of new objectives.
rights: bibliographic identifiers and original synthesis only; no source files redistributed

sources.authors: Rony Novianto; Benjamin Johnston; Mary-Anne Williams
sources.title: Habituation and Sensitisation Learning in ASMO Cognitive Architecture
Flexible attention-based cognitive architecture for robots
sources.access: institutional thesis abstract and rights metadata; full thesis not reviewed; author retains copyright

implemented: Reported companion-robot habituation/sensitisation experiment and robot soccer proof of concept.
learned: Author-reported nonassociative adjustment of attention to repeated or significant events.
designed: Concurrent action processes, attention competition, emotion weighting and learning mechanisms; action repertoire supplied by developer.
limit: No full recovery, dishabituation, stimulus specificity, matched controls or persistence audit yet. Self-modifying label does not establish self-rewriting architecture or newly acquired actions.
ora: Strong comparator for minimal response modulation; differentiate habituation from fatigue, depletion, fixed policy and long-lived learned change.
rights: bibliographic identifiers and original synthesis only; no source files redistributed
